# FDG9070

> DO throw an `ObjectDisposedException` from any member that cannot be used after the object has been disposed of.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.4.1 Basic Dispose Pattern.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

## From the book

```csharp
public class DisposableResourceHolder : IDisposable {
  bool _disposed = false;
  SafeHandle _resource; // handle to a resource

  public void DoSomething() {
    if (_disposed) {
      throw new ObjectDisposedException(...);
    }
    // now call some native methods using the resource
    ...
  }

  protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing) {
    if (_disposed) {
      return;
    }
    // cleanup
    ...
    disposed = true;
  }
}
```
